msg: Ok. Thanks. We will work out the best days. Do you recommend any hotels on the island convenient for the diving?
reply:
Yes! For the most convenient access to diving, I’d recommend *Hotel San Pedro de Majagua* or *Hotel Cocoliso*—our dive base is at both, and pick-up is direct. Other nearby options with maritime access include *Rosario de Mar, Secreto, Ubuntu, Mulata, Eco Hotel Las Palmeras,* and *Pao Pao*. Pick-up arrangements can vary by hotel.

Accommodation isn’t included in the diving plans, so you’d book directly with the hotel. Have you chosen an island or hotel yet?

Where would you be departing from? We can pick you up *from Cartagena* or, if you're already *on the islands*, we arrange pickup at your hotel.

msg: Great. We will book diving with you on the website and will book our hotel on the island . Hope you are operating on Easter Sunday? We want to dive on April 5 and 6. How do we book/pay for the $50 refresher course?

That sounds like a lovely plan! We operate every day of the year except December 25 and January 1, so Easter Sunday is an operating day. I can’t check availability for April 5–6; the booking calendar will show the dates and available spaces.

Since you’ll be staying on the islands, the refresher is booked as *“Dive Mini Course (already on the islands)”*. The online price is *USD 134 per person* (regular price: USD 149), and it includes equipment and dive insurance; lunch isn’t included. The online booking page lets you choose the date and number of people and pay there:

https://book.divingplanet.org/book/dive-mini-course-already-on-island/20?language=en

One important note: a refresher is for certified divers who haven’t dived in more than two years. Since you mentioned having referral certificates and e-learning, please have the team confirm whether the refresher is the right option for completing your referral. Would you like me to connect you with an advisor about that?

Which hotel or island are you staying at? That way we can arrange pickup.
